seo.title: About the Practice
seo.description: ProDenta is a private dental practice on St John's Hill, Battersea, with a focus on prevention and room for the whole family.

heading: About ProDenta
intro: We try to keep dentistry friendly and free of stress, and to keep you comfortable while we work.
story: It is an old saying and we believe it. Good brushing and regular hygiene visits prevent most of the problems we see, so we spend time on both and plan your care over years, not single appointments.

When you need more than routine care, most of it can be done here, including treatment by our visiting specialists. Children are welcome, and it helps to bring them early so that good habits start young.
We will always explain the state of your teeth and gums in plain terms and tell you what you can do to avoid trouble later.

values.title: Your options, explained
values.text: You will know what we recommend, what the alternatives are and what each costs before treatment starts.

values.title: Room for families
values.text: We see children and adults, and we are used to nervous patients of any age.

values.title: Care over the long term
values.text: We would like to see you regularly for check-ups, so that small problems stay small.
